text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered -> service=redwood-inference-embeddings, severity=high, incident_key=PD-54217. Page fired to oncall: @sarah.

sarah: acked. i'm on it, pulling traces and metrics now.

pagerbot: Ack recorded by sarah at 3472105560. Next escalation in 10m if unacked. Duplicate pages suppressed for the same incident key for 5m.

mike: hey sarah — if you want me to take the ownership, i can swap with you. i've got bandwidth.

sarah: @mike could you take this if it's embedding-related? i'm seeing a spike in 500s from the embeddings pipeline. looks like queue processing failing on region-us-west-2.

mike: i’m taking it. claiming ownership. moving to incident channel.

mike: quick triage notes:
```
- error: kv_cache miss -> downstream 500 in embed-worker
- stacktrace snippet: EmbeddingService.ProcessBatch -> grpc: upstream closed
- first spike at 23:12:08 UTC, rate ~ 240 rps -> 5xx rate ~ 18% for embeddings route
```

mike: checking infra: autoscaler reports scale events but pods are flapping. suspect regression in recent deploy (deploy id: canary-2026-03-12-9f3a).

devin: tagging infra and runtime: @ops-bot can you pull the pod logs and node OOMs? also, any recent hotfixes to the kv cache?

ops-bot: collected latest logs (links): https://internal.logs/PD-54217/; top error is `grpc: connection refused` from embed-worker. no OOMs on nodes, but one worker restarted 3x in last 8m.

mike: rolling back canary on embeddings worker now to previous stable (canary-2026-03-11-a7b2). executing: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embed-worker embed-worker=redwood/embed:stable-a7b2 && kubectl rollout status deploy/embed-worker`

sarah: while rollback runs, what's customer impact? any big customers affected?

mike: looking at affected tenants: 3 customers with high QPS, one enterprise customer (acme-inc) has ~30% of those requests failing. customer-facing impact: elevated error rates for embeddings -> feature degradation (search/recos).

mike: suppression note: i adjusted PagerDuty routing to avoid duplicate pages to the general embeddings alias while we stabilize. used `pagerbot suppress --incident PD-54217 --duration 300s --reason "stabilizing rollback"`

pagerbot: suppression applied. duplicate page fanout to #embeddings-group suppressed for 5m. escalation timers paused while suppression active.

devin: please add a short customer update to support. we should be transparent: brief, what we're doing, ETA. @tanya can you draft?

tanya: draft below — feel free to edit: 
```
Hi team — we detected elevated errors affecting embeddings in US-West. Our engineering team is rolling back a recent canary which should restore service within ~10 minutes. We will update once rollout completes. Apologies for the disruption. — Redwood Inference
```

mike: looks good. sending now to ACME support channel. also adding temporary alert tweak to reduce noise: change threshold from 5% to 10% for 1m window so small bursts don't page. will revert after postmortem.

sarah: rollback completed, new pods stable (status green). 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 1.2% over last 3m.

mike: verifying traces: kv_cache errors no longer present. signal shows normalizing. keeping suppression for another 2m to avoid dup churn.

pagerbot: auto-escalation timer resumed; next escalation in 8m if state changes.

devin: good job. next steps: postmortem to root cause: investigate canary gating, add more conservative failure-mode for kv cache, and tighten health checks to avoid partial flaps.

mike: filing follow-up tasks: TASK-1287 (rollback root cause), TASK-1288 (adjust alert thresholds), TASK-1289 (customer comms audit).

ops-bot: recorded incident timeline and metrics snapshot: 23:12:08 first spike, 23:14:27 rollback started, 23:16:10 pods stable, 23:18:40 error rates within normal.

mike: closing incident PD-54217 from my side. will add detailed notes to postmortem doc. thanks all. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: incident PD-54217 marked resolved by mike at 3472105625.

sarah: quick retro: consider enabling a short suppression window and a distinct customer-impact alert that pages only when >2 enterprise tenants are impacted. otherwise noise leads to cognitive load during night shifts.

mike: agreed. adding to TASK-1288.

tanya: support update sent to ACME. they acknowledged and are monitoring.

pag­erbot_note: (bot) follow-up: please attach logs and the deploy diff to the postmortem. suggested severity: Sev-2.

mike: noted, attaching links in postmortem.

sarah: thanks team. moving back to rotation.
